summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes 728KB obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js], {stdio:'inherit'})`. `math_init.js` is a 727,680-byte heavily obfuscated bundle using a rotated numeric/string constant array and a `WV8StW` array-shuffle decoder with hex-mangled identifiers. A TanStack Query + MobX binding library has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or for install-time execution of an opaque bundle; the alternate runtime also evades Node-based scanners that would otherwise see the payload's runtime behavior. The cover-story filename (`math_init.js`) conflicts with the package's declared purpose and shipped contents. Installing this package results in arbitrary attacker-controlled code executing on the installer's machine under a freshly downloaded interpreter.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
